value.rationale: V: An explicit research question asks whether all canonical tensor-generation obstructions in this four-parameter nonprojective toric family arise from invariant (-1,-1)-curves. The result disproves that possibility in an infinite family where every one of 18 invariant curves has nonzero canonical degree; it identifies a geometric obstructing surface, exact restricted divisor class, and a non-invariant rational degree-zero curve. This demonstrates a concrete limit of invariant-curve wall tests in a recent algebraic-geometric family; it is not a generic textbook example or merely a numerical negative check.
